subject: PE
title: PE 4
description: Grade 4 physical education aligned to the California Physical Education Model Content Standards and Framework. Students refine manipulative skills (overhand throwing, catching, foot dribbling, hand dribbling, striking and volleying), perform long-rope jumping, balance stunts and folk dances, and apply movement concepts and simple strategies in small-sided games. Fitness is assessed with FITNESSGRAM-style tests at the start and end of the year, and students set personal goals, track heart rate and practice cooperation and sportsmanship.
framework: California Physical Education Model Content Standards (Grade 4); 2009 California Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-4.1.1: Perform simple small-group balance stunts by distributing weight and base of support.
standards.PE-4.1.2: Perform intermediate-level, long-rope jumping skills (e.g., entering and exiting a turning rope, double turns).
standards.PE-4.1.3: Perform locomotor and nonlocomotor movements in rhythmic patterns and folk/line dances.
standards.PE-4.1.4: Throw a ball overhand with accuracy to a target and for distance using mature form.
standards.PE-4.1.5: Catch a thrown or kicked ball above the waist, below the waist and while moving.
standards.PE-4.1.6: Dribble and pass a ball with the feet (inside and outside of the foot) while moving and changing direction.
standards.PE-4.1.7: Dribble a ball with the hands while moving, changing speed and direction, and pass to a moving partner.
standards.PE-4.1.8: Strike an object with a paddle, racket or bat using a sideways orientation and controlled force.
standards.PE-4.1.9: Volley an object upward and to a partner using hands and forearms.
standards.PE-4.2.1: Explain how to use body position, force and follow-through to improve throwing, kicking and striking.
standards.PE-4.2.2: Explain how to create and reduce space when moving with others in game situations (offense and defense).
standards.PE-4.2.3: Design and refine a movement sequence or dance using changes in level, pathway, tempo and force.
standards.PE-4.3.1: Participate in moderate-to-vigorous physical activity for increasing periods of time (aerobic capacity).
standards.PE-4.3.2: Perform exercises that build muscular strength and endurance (curl-ups, push-ups).
standards.PE-4.3.3: Perform exercises that improve flexibility (trunk lift, sit-and-reach).
standards.PE-4.3.4: Assess personal fitness with standardized tests and set short-term fitness goals.
standards.PE-4.3.5: Monitor heart rate before, during and after physical activity.
standards.PE-4.4.1: Explain the relationship between heart rate, breathing and intensity of physical activity.
standards.PE-4.4.2: Identify the five components of health-related fitness and activities that develop each.
standards.PE-4.4.3: Explain the importance of warm-up, cool-down, hydration and safety in physical activity.
standards.PE-4.5.1: Demonstrate sportsmanship and respect for others during activities, winning or losing.
standards.PE-4.5.2: Work cooperatively with a partner or small group to solve movement problems and accomplish goals.
standards.PE-4.5.3: Use conflict-resolution strategies (e.g., rock-paper-scissors, talk it out, take turns) during games.

units.title: Fitness Foundations and Pre-Assessment
units.big_idea: Knowing our starting fitness lets us set goals and track growth.

units.title: Throwing and Catching
units.big_idea: Stepping with the opposite foot, rotating and following through produce accurate, powerful throws.

units.title: Foot Skills: Dribble, Pass and Trap
units.big_idea: Soft touches and open space help a team keep and move the ball.

units.title: Jump Rope and Rhythm
units.big_idea: Timing and rhythm let us jump individually and with long ropes for fun fitness.

units.title: Balance, Tumbling and Stunts
units.big_idea: A wide, low base of support makes balances stable, alone and in groups.

units.title: Hand Dribbling and Passing
units.big_idea: Dribbling with fingerpads and eyes up lets us move and pass to open teammates.

units.title: Folk and Line Dance
units.big_idea: Dance builds rhythm and connects us to the cultures of California.

units.title: Striking and Volleying
units.big_idea: A side-facing stance, level swing and firm contact control where the object goes.

units.title: Cooperative and Strategy Games
units.big_idea: Teams win by communicating, creating space and playing fair.

units.title: Fitness Post-Assessment and Field Day
units.big_idea: Comparing results shows growth and helps plan lifelong activity.

objectives: Perform a dynamic warm-up and cool-down
Measure resting and active heart rate

days.title: Dynamic warm-up
days.work: Learn a 5-minute warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, arm circles, lunges, inchworms) and lead it once.

days.title: Find your pulse
days.work: Count your pulse for 15 seconds at rest, multiply by 4, and log it; repeat after 2 minutes of jumping jacks.

days.title: Heart rate zones
days.work: Do 3 activities of different intensity (walk, jog, sprint) and record heart rate after each.

days.title: Cool-down & hydration
days.work: Learn 4 static stretches for the cool-down and track water intake for the day.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain to a parent why heart rate rises with intensity and lead the full warm-up and cool-down.

weeks.assessment: Heart rate log and led warm-up.

days.title: Five components
days.work: Match 10 activities to the five health-related fitness components.

days.title: PACER or mile
days.work: Complete the 20-meter PACER (or a timed 1-mile walk/run) and record laps or time.

days.title: Curl-ups & push-ups
days.work: Complete cadence curl-ups and 90-degree push-ups tests and record results.

days.title: Trunk lift & sit-and-reach
days.work: Complete trunk lift and back-saver sit-and-reach tests and record results.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Compare results to Healthy Fitness Zone charts with a parent.

days.title: SMART goals
days.work: Write two SMART fitness goals based on pre-assessment results.

days.title: Circuit design
days.work: Set up a 6-station circuit (jumping jacks, plank, wall sit, jump rope, step-ups, crab walk) for 40 seconds each.

days.title: Circuit day
days.work: Complete the circuit twice with 20-second rests and log repetitions.

days.title: Family challenge
days.work: Teach a family member the circuit and complete it together.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Repeat the circuit and compare repetitions to day 3.

days.title: Cues
days.work: Learn the cues: side to target, arm back, step with opposite foot, rotate hips, follow through.

days.title: Wall throws
days.work: Throw 30 balls at a taped wall target from 15 feet, focusing on stepping.

days.title: Video check
days.work: Record your throw in slow motion and check each cue.

days.title: Distance throws
days.work: Throw for distance 10 times and measure the best three.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate a throw while a parent scores the 5 cues.

objectives: Catch above and below the waist

days.title: Hand position
days.work: Practice thumbs-together catches high and pinkies-together catches low (30 tosses).

days.title: Partner catch
days.work: Play partner catch, stepping back after every 3 successful catches.

days.title: Moving catch
days.work: Run a pattern and catch a ball tossed ahead of you.

days.title: Bounce catch
days.work: Play a reaction-bounce game with a playground ball.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a 20-catch test at three levels and record the score.

days.title: Lead passes
days.work: Throw to a partner jogging across the yard, aiming ahead of them.

days.title: Disc throw
days.work: Learn the backhand flying-disc throw and complete 20 partner throws.

days.title: Football spiral
days.work: Practice gripping and throwing a junior football in a spiral.

days.title: Target game
days.work: Play a 'hit the cone' accuracy game from three distances.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Score accuracy on 10 throws to a moving partner.

days.title: Ultimate disc basics
days.work: Learn ultimate disc rules (no running with the disc, pivot foot) and play a 2-on-2 game.

days.title: Sportsmanship talk
days.work: List 5 sportsmanship behaviors and practice them in a game.

days.title: Hot potato relay
days.work: Play a timed throwing and catching relay with family.

days.title: Skill review
days.work: Review throwing and catching cues by teaching them to a sibling or parent.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Complete a throwing and catching skills test and a sportsmanship self-rating.

objectives: Dribble with inside and outside of the foot

days.title: Touches
days.work: Practice toe taps, inside-inside touches and sole rolls for 5 minutes.

days.title: Cone weave
days.work: Dribble through 6 cones using inside and outside of the foot.

days.title: Speed changes
days.work: Dribble at walking, jogging and running speed on a whistle.

days.title: Red light, green light
days.work: Play dribbling red light, green light, stopping the ball with the sole.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Time a cone-weave dribble 3 times and record the best.

objectives: Pass with the inside of the foot

days.title: Inside-foot pass
days.work: Pass to a wall 30 times with each foot, plant foot beside the ball.

days.title: Trapping
days.work: Trap balls rolled at different speeds with sole and inside of foot.

days.title: Partner passing
days.work: Pass back and forth with a partner, increasing distance.

days.title: Gate passing
days.work: Pass through cone gates scattered across the yard.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Count successful passes through a gate in 2 minutes.

days.title: Open space
days.work: Play keep-away 2-on-1, moving to open space to receive.

days.title: Defense
days.work: Practice defensive stance and staying goal-side.

days.title: Small-sided game
days.work: Play a 2-on-2 game with small cone goals.

days.title: Strategy talk
days.work: Draw a diagram showing how to create space on offense.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Self-assess moving to space using a 3-point checklist.

days.title: Skills stations
days.work: Rotate through dribbling, passing and shooting stations.

days.title: Conflict resolution
days.work: Practice resolving a disputed call with rock-paper-scissors.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play a family soccer game with rules.

days.title: Refereeing
days.work: Referee a short game and make fair calls.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Complete a foot skills test.

objectives: Perform basic and intermediate short-rope jumps

days.title: Rope sizing & basic bounce
days.work: Size the rope (handles reach armpits when standing on its center) and practice the basic two-foot bounce for 4 sets of 30 seconds.

days.title: Skier and bell
days.work: Learn the skier (side-to-side) and bell (front-to-back) jumps and do 20 of each without missing.

days.title: Criss-cross
days.work: Practice the criss-cross by crossing arms at the waist on every third jump; count successful crosses.

days.title: Endurance intervals
days.work: Jump five 30-second intervals with 30-second rests, recording jumps per interval and heart rate.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform a 4-trick routine (bounce, skier, bell, criss-cross) for a parent who scores it.

objectives: Enter and exit a turning long rope
materials: a partner or a post to tie one end

days.title: Turning
days.work: Practice turning a long rope with a partner, making full circles that tap the ground on each beat.

days.title: Front door
days.work: Enter the 'front door' as the rope comes toward you, jump 5 times and run out the far side.

days.title: Back door
days.work: Enter through the 'back door' (rope moving away) by waiting for it to hit the ground and following it in.

days.title: Chants
days.work: Jump to traditional rope chants like 'Teddy Bear, Teddy Bear' while doing the actions.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform a front-door entry, 10 jumps with a turn-around, and a clean exit.

objectives: Try Double Dutch turning and entry
Jump with a partner in one rope

days.title: Partner jumping
days.work: Jump side-by-side with a partner sharing one short rope, each turning one handle.

days.title: Double Dutch turning
days.work: Practice 'eggbeater' turning of two ropes in alternating circles with a family member and a post.

days.title: Double Dutch entry
days.work: Rock in time with the back rope, then enter and try 3 jumps; count best streak.

days.title: Routine design
days.work: With a partner, design a 4-part routine mixing partner jumps and single-rope tricks.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the partner routine and give each other one compliment and one tip.

objectives: Use jump rope for aerobic fitness
Perform a rhythmic routine to music

days.title: Tabata jump
days.work: Do a 4-minute Tabata (20 seconds jumping, 10 seconds rest) and record heart rate after.

days.title: Choreograph
days.work: Choose a song and choreograph a 1-minute routine with at least 5 tricks matched to the beat.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse the routine 5 times, fixing any spot where you miss.

days.title: Perform
days.work: Perform the routine for family as a 'Jump Rope Show'.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Complete the jump rope skills test: 1-minute speed count, 3 tricks and long-rope entry.

objectives: Hold static balances with different bases of support
Explain why wide, low bases are stable

days.title: Bases of support
days.work: Hold 8 balances on different body parts (two hands and one foot, one knee and one hand) for 5 seconds each.

days.title: Stable or not?
days.work: Test narrow vs wide stances and explain which is more stable using 'center of gravity'.

days.title: Yoga balances
days.work: Practice tree, warrior III and boat pose, holding each for 15 seconds.

days.title: Safety
days.work: Learn safe falling (tuck and roll sideways) and spotting rules.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform 3 balances of your choice and explain the base of support for each.

objectives: Perform log roll, forward roll and cartwheel progressions safely

days.title: Rolls
days.work: Practice log rolls and egg rolls, then a forward roll down a gentle incline with chin tucked.

days.title: Cartwheel progression
days.work: Practice hand-hand-foot-foot along a line, then a lunge-to-cartwheel.

days.title: Flexibility
days.work: Do bridge, straddle stretch and butterfly stretch to improve tumbling flexibility.

days.title: Combine
days.work: Link a forward roll, stand, and balance into a smooth sequence.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform the forward roll and cartwheel for a parent who checks safety cues.

objectives: Perform small-group balances by distributing weight

days.title: Counterbalance
days.work: Practice partner sit-ups-to-stand back-to-back and lean-away holds with hands joined.

days.title: Partner stunts
days.work: Try partner balances such as the 'thigh stand' with a spotter, holding for 3 seconds.

days.title: Strength builders
days.work: Do planks, superman holds and wall sits to build the strength stunts need.

days.title: Group shape
days.work: With 2-3 family members, create a group balance that has at least 4 points of contact with the floor.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform 2 partner stunts and the group balance; discuss what communication made them work.

objectives: Design a movement sequence with balance, rolls and changes in level

days.title: Plan
days.work: Plan a routine with a start shape, 2 balances, 1 roll, 1 jump and a finish, using high, medium and low levels.

days.title: Transitions
days.work: Practice smooth transitions between each element.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse the routine 5 times and record it.

days.title: Peer feedback
days.work: Watch the recording with a parent and revise one transition.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Perform the final routine; scored on control, levels, transitions and safety.

objectives: Dribble with fingerpads keeping eyes up
Dribble while changing speed and direction

days.title: Stationary
days.work: Practice pound dribbles, low dribbles and figure-8s around the legs with each hand.

days.title: Eyes up
days.work: Dribble while calling out the number of fingers a parent holds up.

days.title: Moving dribble
days.work: Dribble down and back on a line with right, left, then alternating hands.

days.title: Crossover
days.work: Learn the crossover dribble around cones.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a timed cone dribble course using both hands.

objectives: Use chest, bounce and overhead passes

days.title: Chest pass
days.work: Practice 30 chest passes to a wall target, stepping into each pass.

days.title: Bounce pass
days.work: Practice bounce passes that hit two-thirds of the way to the partner.

days.title: Overhead pass
days.work: Practice overhead passes and when to use them.

days.title: Moving passes
days.work: Pass to a partner jogging across the yard and catch with 'target hands'.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Score 10 of each pass type to a partner.

materials: basketball and lowered hoop or laundry basket

days.title: BEEF shooting
days.work: Shoot 30 shots close to the hoop using BEEF cues.

days.title: Give-and-go
days.work: Practice give-and-go passing with a partner.

days.title: Defense
days.work: Practice defensive slide and keeping between the player and the basket.

days.title: 2-on-1
days.work: Play 2-on-1 with a passer, cutter and defender.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Self-assess BEEF cues on video.

objectives: Apply dribbling, passing and shooting in games

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn rules for traveling, double dribble and fouls and demonstrate each.

days.title: Half-court game
days.work: Play a 2-on-2 half-court game to 7 points.

days.title: Conflict scenarios
days.work: Act out 3 disputed calls and resolve each with a fair strategy.

days.title: Skills stations
days.work: Rotate through dribble, pass and shoot stations.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Complete the hand dribble and passing skills test.

objectives: Perform steps of a Mexican folk dance

days.title: Watch & discuss
days.work: Watch a ballet folklórico performance video and describe the footwork and costumes.

days.title: La Raspa steps
days.work: Learn the La Raspa bleking step (alternating heels) in time with the music.

days.title: Partner figure
days.work: Learn the elbow-swing partner figure of La Raspa and connect it to the bleking section.

days.title: Full dance
days.work: Perform La Raspa from start to finish with a family member three times.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform for family and explain where the dance comes from.

objectives: Perform square dance calls and a line dance
Move with a partner and group
materials: square dance or Virginia reel music

days.title: Square dance calls
days.work: Learn do-si-do, swing your partner, promenade and allemande left.

days.title: Virginia reel
days.work: Dance the Virginia reel with family members.

days.title: Grapevine
days.work: Learn the grapevine step and a 4-wall line dance (e.g., Cha Cha Slide).

days.title: Heart rate
days.work: Measure heart rate after dancing and compare to jogging.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform a sequence of called square dance moves without stopping.

objectives: Design a dance using level, pathway, tempo and force

days.title: Plan
days.work: Choose music and plan 4 eight-count sections using changes in level, pathway, tempo and force.

days.title: Teach
days.work: Teach your dance to a family member.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse and refine transitions.

days.title: Perform
days.work: Perform the dance for an audience.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Self-assess the dance with a rubric and complete a dance steps check.

objectives: Strike a ball with a paddle using a side-facing stance

days.title: Grip & bumps
days.work: Learn the shake-hands grip and bump a ball upward 20 times.

days.title: Forehand
days.work: Practice forehand strikes against a wall from a sideways stance.

days.title: Backhand
days.work: Practice backhand strikes against a wall.

days.title: Rally
days.work: Rally with a partner over a low net (string between chairs).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Count your longest wall rally with forehand and backhand.

objectives: Strike a ball off a tee and from a toss

days.title: Stance & grip
days.work: Practice batting stance and grip with knuckles aligned.

days.title: Tee hitting
days.work: Hit 30 balls off a tee aiming for level swings.

days.title: Soft toss
days.work: Hit soft-tossed balls from a parent.

days.title: Fielding
days.work: Practice fielding grounders and throwing to a base.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Play a game of whiffle ball with family and track hits.

objectives: Volley a ball upward with hands and forearms

days.title: Hand volley
days.work: Volley a beach ball upward with fingertips 20 times.

days.title: Forearm pass
days.work: Practice the bump with a platform of forearms.

days.title: Partner rally
days.work: Rally with a partner using sets and bumps.

days.title: Net game
days.work: Play a cooperative over-the-net game, counting consecutive hits.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Record your best cooperative rally.

days.title: Pickleball basics
days.work: Learn pickleball serve and scoring with family.

days.title: Mini-tournament
days.work: Play a family pickleball or paddle tournament.

days.title: Newcomb ball
days.work: Play Newcomb ball (catch-and-throw volleyball).

days.title: Sportsmanship
days.work: Write how you showed sportsmanship.

days.title: Unit assessment
days.work: Complete a striking and volleying skills test.

objectives: Solve movement problems with a group

days.title: Hula hoop pass
days.work: Pass a hula hoop around a circle of family members without letting go of hands; time three tries and improve.

days.title: Blindfold course
days.work: Guide a blindfolded partner through a cone course using words only, then switch roles.

days.title: Lava river
days.work: Cross a 10-foot 'lava river' as a group using only 3 paper-plate stepping stones.

days.title: Debrief
days.work: List the words and actions that helped the group succeed and one thing that caused frustration.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Complete a cooperation self-rating (listening, encouraging, sharing ideas) and set one improvement goal.

objectives: Use dodging and faking to create space
Apply simple offensive and defensive strategies

days.title: Dodging
days.work: Practice dodging, faking and pivoting in a 'shadow' drill with a partner.

days.title: Flag tag
days.work: Play flag tag in a coned area, using fakes to keep your flags.

days.title: Capture the flag
days.work: Play capture the flag with family or neighbors, assigning defenders and attackers.

days.title: Strategy board
days.work: Draw a strategy diagram for your team and test it in a rematch.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write which strategy worked best and why, and how your team handled disagreements.

objectives: Invent a game that uses grade 4 skills
Write fair rules and teach them

days.title: Plan
days.work: Invent a game combining at least two skills (e.g., foot dribble and throwing) and list equipment and boundaries.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Write 5 rules, a scoring system and a safety rule on a poster.

days.title: Test
days.work: Play-test the game with family and note problems.

days.title: Revise
days.work: Revise rules to make the game fairer and more active.

days.title: Teach & play
days.work: Teach the final game to a new player and lead a full game.

days.title: Warm-up & PACER
days.work: Lead your dynamic warm-up and complete the PACER (or 1-mile run) and record the result.

days.title: Curl-ups & push-ups
days.work: Complete the curl-up and push-up tests.

days.title: Trunk lift & sit-and-reach
days.work: Complete the trunk lift and sit-and-reach tests.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Graph pre- and post-test results side by side and check which goals you met.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Write a paragraph explaining what training helped most.

objectives: Explain how heart rate and fitness components connect

days.title: Fitness components quiz
days.work: Take a quiz on the five fitness components and heart rate concepts.

days.title: Favorite activities
days.work: List 10 activities you enjoy and which fitness component each builds.

days.title: Summer plan
days.work: Write a 4-week summer plan with 60 minutes of activity daily using frequency, intensity, time and type.

days.title: Try something new
days.work: Try a new activity (hiking trail, swimming, skating) and log heart rate.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Present your plan to family and post it on the fridge.

objectives: Apply the year's skills in a field day

days.title: Plan field day
days.work: Plan 6 stations (sack race, accuracy throw, jump rope contest, dribble relay, tug-of-war, water relay) and make station signs.

days.title: Set up
days.work: Measure and set up stations safely and prepare a score card.

days.title: Field day
days.work: Run field day with family or friends, rotating through all stations.

days.title: Awards
days.work: Make sportsmanship awards for every participant.

days.title: Year reflection
days.work: Write a reflection on your favorite unit and the skill you improved most.
